levels.label: L0 - Manual Control (0% Automation)
levels.description: Zero auto-write; 100% of documents and fields are queued for Human Review.

levels.label: L1 - Conservative Triage (Strict Exact Matches)
levels.description: Auto-writes 100% exact raw text matches with zero validator failures; fuzzy & ungrounded fields go to review.

levels.label: L2 - Balanced Agent + Audit (Default Standard)
levels.description: Auto-writes agreeing SI vs BL fields with confidence >= 0.90; mismatches go to review with post-hoc audit.

levels.label: L3 - Full Autonomous Straight-Through Processing
levels.description: High-autonomy straight-through processing for trusted carriers; auto-writes all valid extracted fields without audit.
